title: Multilingual Resources for Migrant Workers NSW - Practical workplace resources
topic: support/referral organisation; workplace safety and rights resources
content: Source PDF filename: rmwc_workplace_rights_vi.pdf; source PDF pages: 3 and 9-10.
RMWC says its resources provide practical information about staying safe at work, responding to unsafe working conditions, understanding workplace rights and recognising workplace exploitation.
The document says materials are developed in languages other than English to help workers access information in culturally safe and accessible ways.
The resources page links to legal help, multilingual resources, research reports, Labour Hire Toolkit videos, enquiries and requests for sessions.
Publication date is not stated in the PDF; access date is 13 September 2026.
